messages:
anya: Heads-up — onboarding CascadeFusion-v2 (int4) into dedi pool. Noticing coherent outputs until ~1.8k tokens then sudden topic collapse/hallucination. Short ctx looks fine. Repro: /mnt/canary/cascadefusion_long_repro.ipynb.

ryan: Can you drop a minimal failing input? curious if it's tokenization related or kv-state.

anya: Pasted snippet (trimmed): ```
... 
input_tokens[1765:1776] = [5012, 872, 21, 823, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
model_out[1765:1776] = ["the", "", "", "", "", ...]
```

lei: That pattern of zeros + empty tokens screams kv-address wrap or a token-id remap. Which convert pipeline did you use? any custom head-packing?

anya: redwood-model-convert v1.2. Used inttool v2.3, with `--pack-heads packed` (default). No manual reorder flags.

ryan: Quick check: dump of kv pointers at t=1768 shows repeated address 0x0 starting at head index 6. `infratools.kv_dump --model cascadefusion-v2 --idx 1760-1780`. Also saw rotary phase angles for head 6..9 are near-opposite of head 0..3.

lei: Could be head-interleave vs contiguous assumption mismatch. Some checkpoints use interleaved head layout (h0,hN,h1,hN+1) for fused proj kernels; our pack expects contiguous (h0..hN). If convert didn't record layout, pack/unpack will misplace halves of q/k and rotary will pair wrong heads.

anya: I diffed the serialized attention metadata and found `head_layout: interleaved` in original but `head_layout: contiguous` in converted descriptor. Patch shows a missing tag write in convert for certain blocks.

ryan: That matches. Two quick mitigations: 1) force fallback to fp16 for longctx routes via routing rule `route.longctx.model = fp16-cascadefusion-v2`. 2) add a convert-time assertion to fail when original metadata contradicts target layout.

ci-bot: CI job `longctx-smoke/canary-1715600000` started.

lei: I've started a kernel-bisect matrix on the canary: variables = [head_layout: interleaved|contiguous, pack: packed|native, projorder: qkv|kqv]. Running 6 permutations now in parallel.

anya: Nice. Results (partial): interleaved + packed + qkv -> FAIL (collapse at 1.8k). contiguous + packed + qkv -> PASS (no collapse to 4k). interleaved + native + qkv -> PASS. So pack vs native seems to matter only when layout tag mismatch exists.

ryan: So root cause: convert dropped head_layout tag for some attention blocks; packed kernel assumed contiguous layout -> misplacement -> rotary/head pairing wrong. When using native packing, kernel handles both. When pack==packed, we need correct layout metadata.

lei: Proposed fixes: 1) hotfix convert to preserve head_layout for all blocks, 2) change default pack to native for canary until patch lands, 3) add conversion CI test that roundtrips head_layout tag by comparing original descriptor.

anya: Implementing patch now. One nuance: some fused kernels expect projorder=kqv; converting blindly to qkv might break other models. We'll add `--preserve-projorder` to convert and a per-checkpoint metadata check.

ci-bot: Job `longctx-smoke/canary-1715600000` update: three permutations done, two passed, one failed (interleaved+packed+qkv).

ops: Rolling routing fallback to fp16 for longctx routes as temporary mitigation. Notifying infra.

ryan: After patch applied locally, quick eval numbers: shortctx ppl: fp16=11.4, patched-int4=11.8; longctx rouge delta vs fp16: patched-int4 = -0.8 (acceptable). Will push convert PR.

anya: Filing PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-convert/pull/312 (includes head_layout persistence, --preserve-projorder flag, and a unit test that constructs a synthetic interleaved layout and asserts identical kv addresses post-conversion).

lei: One more sanity add: tokenizer sanity check for zero-width joiner/ZWJ and NFKC normal forms. We saw a couple edge inputs where normalization changed token boundaries, exacerbating cache alignment issues. Add `tokenizer.normalize(..., form='NFKC')` into conversion pipeline and CI fuzz tests.

anya: Agree. I'll add both the head-layout guard and tokenizer normalization smoke to the PR.

ci-bot: All canary tests green after patch (longctx-smoke now PASS), promoting to canary-r11.

ryan: Follow-up: update docs in `docs/onboarding.md` with a short checklist: head_layout, projorder, pack method, tokenizer normalization, longctx-smoke. Saves future triage time.

anya: Thanks all. Leaving notes in the onboarding ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENGML-4522.

lei: Will open a small monitoring alert: if entropy of token distribution drops by >30% over 200 tokens in flows >2k, auto-route to fp16.

anya: Done. Thanks :thumbsup:
